proof_body:
by
  intro a s hanti h0 hs n
  have hnn : ∀ m, 0 ≤ a m := fun m => hanti.le_of_tendsto h0 m
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd' n with ⟨k, rfl | rfl⟩
  · have h1 := hanti.alternating_series_le_tendsto hs k
    have h2 := hanti.tendsto_le_alternating_series hs k
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, pow_mul] at h2
    simp only [neg_one_sq, one_pow, one_mul] at h2
    have h3 := hnn (2 * k)
    exact abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · have h1 := hanti.alternating_series_le_tendsto hs (k + 1)
    have h2 := hanti.tendsto_le_alternating_series hs k
    have e : 2 * (k + 1) = 2 * k + 1 + 1 := by ring
    rw [e, Finset.sum_range_succ, pow_succ, pow_mul] at h1
    simp only [neg_one_sq, one_pow, one_mul] at h1
    have h3 := hnn (2 * k + 1)
    exact abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (s : ℝ), Antitone a → Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds 0) → Filter.Tendsto (fun m => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (-1 : ℝ) ^ i * a i) Filter.atTop (nhds s) → ∀ n, |s - ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (-1 : ℝ) ^ i * a i| ≤ a n
